text:
alex: FYI CI just flagged a p95 uptick in the small-batch nightly suite — ~7% vs baseline. job: nightly/small-batch/2412345600. stacktrace attached in artifacts. :eyes:

priya: ugh, saw that in the alert. is it localized to one model or broad? any change in input lengths?

alex: seems concentrated on the 2k-token convolution tests (seqlen 2048). baseline run vs current run diff: increased kernel stalls reported by nvprof. link: https://ci.internal/runs/2412345600/artifacts

sam: can someone grab `perf trace` and `nvidia-smi dmon` from the run? if it's GPU scheduling we might see higher SM utilization variance.

maria: grabbing logs now. also starting a quick repro on top-of-tree with the nightly config. ETA ~20m.

ci-bot: [alert] nightly perf - small-batch - p95 +7% - run 2412345600 - artifacts uploaded - https://ci.internal/runs/2412345600

priya: thanks. if repro is fast, let's try a narrow bisect: revert PRs that touched kernel selection or batching in the last 48h. suspects: #3821 (kv-cache change), #3834 (small-batch scheduler).

alex: noted. I can spin a bisect job that toggles those flags. command I used locally: ```./tools/bench_runner --suite small-batch --seq-len 2048 --iters 50 --gpu 0```

sam: when you run, capture `nvprof --print-gpu-trace` (or nsight sys) and the runtime logs (`/var/log/redwood/runtime.log`). paste relevant kernel times.

maria: repro landed: current main shows the regression. rolling a job now with `--batcher=old` to see if scheduler default changed anything.

priya: also try `--enabled-prefix-cache=false` in case prefix cache change is affecting KV hotpaths.

alex: creating two CI jobs: one with batcher=old, one with prefix-cache off. names: perf/mini-bisect/2412345678-1 and -2. kicking them now.

ci-bot: job started perf/mini-bisect/2412345678-1 (batcher=old)
ci-bot: job started perf/mini-bisect/2412345678-2 (prefix-cache=false)

sam: if both jobs reproduce, we'll need to bisect commits. if only one fixes, we have a narrower culprit. thanks for the quick turn.

maria: initial nvprof from repro: several kernels show 12-18% longer avg duration (attention forward kernel). attaching snippet: ```AttentionForwardKernel  avg 1.12ms -> 1.27ms```

priya: attention kernel increase aligns with scheduler change in #3834 — that PR introduced a different launch configuration for small batches. alex, can you try launching with the previous kernel config? there's a flag `--kernel-launch=legacy` that simulates old grid/block sizes.

alex: started new job perf/mini-bisect/2412345678-3 with `--kernel-launch=legacy`.

ci-bot: job started perf/mini-bisect/2412345678-3 (kernel-launch=legacy)

maria: quick numbers from the three runs (median over 25 iters):
- main: p95 148ms
- batcher=old: p95 139ms
- prefix-cache=false: p95 149ms
- kernel-launch=legacy: p95 140ms

priya: looks like kernel-launch and batcher=old both reduce p95 back toward baseline. prefix-cache toggle didn't help. that points at #3834 kernel/scheduler changes.

sam: agree. next step: prepare a minimal repro CL that rolls back the kernel-launch portion of #3834 and run it through the nightly bench. can someone own the CL and the bisect?

alex: I'll open a revert PR for the kernel launch bits and run the full small-batch nightly. assigning to @alex for the PR and @maria for verification.

maria: ack. I'll run the full suite once the PR lands. if it fixes, we can either revert or patch the launch config to keep other improvements.

priya: please tag me on the PR. also add a short perf note in the PR body with the mini-bisect numbers above and attach nvprof traces.

ci-bot: update: perf/mini-bisect/2412345678-3 finished - p95 141ms (improvement) - artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/2412346030/artifacts

alex: PR opened: r/redwood/runtime#3842 - revert kernel-launch changes from #3834. description includes mini-bisect numbers and nvprof links.

sam: nice. once the PR passes CI, let's stage to a canary nightly next window and monitor for regressions. also schedule a follow-up to rework the launch heuristics with perf tests covering seqlen=2048.

priya: adding an action item: create a small benchmark in our nightly matrix that specifically exercises seqlen 2048 attention kernels so future regressions catch early. filing ticket INF-642.

maria: putting logs and traces into the incident folder: `s3://redwood-perf/incidents/2412345678/`

alex: thanks all. I'll post updates here when the PR CI finishes. :thumbsup:
